capturePage.title: Pin your terminal location
capturePage.description: Share your GPS location to confirm a bus terminal on Moja Ride.
capturePage.introDesc: An operator asked you to confirm the exact location of {terminal}. Your GPS position is used once to look up the address and is never shared publicly.
capturePage.privacyNote: Your location is used only to resolve the terminal address and stays private.
capturePage.previewDesc: Check the address below, then confirm. A Moja Ride operator will approve it before the terminal goes live.
capturePage.phonePlaceholder: So the operator can reach you
capturePage.accuracyBad: GPS signal is weak ({accuracy}m). Move to an open area and try again.
capturePage.doneDesc: Thank you! The operator will review this location and confirm the terminal shortly.
capturePage.continueConfirm: Your location was already shared. Confirm it below.
capturePage.invalidLink: This capture link is invalid or has expired. Please ask the operator for a new one.
capturePage.expiredLink: This capture link has expired. Please ask the operator for a new one.
capturePage.rejectedLink: This capture link was rejected by the operator. Please ask for a new one.
capturePage.permissionDeniedDesc: Enable location access for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
capturePage.locateFailedDesc: Check your GPS and internet connection, then try again.
